about_the_game:
Flesh and Fury transports players to a brutal world set one million years BC, where a savage tyrant rules with an iron fist. In this ruthless era, the deranged warlord Don Hara orchestrates deadly gladiatorial battles between beautiful women, who must fight for the right to survive another day—and for the twisted "honor" of sharing his bed.

At the top of this cruel hierarchy stands Vera, the arena's reigning champion. A fierce and unforgiving gladiator, she secretly defies Don Hara by having an illicit affair with his personal guard, Thal. Their betrayal adds another layer of tension and danger to the already deadly games.

Our protagonist is a young girl from a nomadic desert tribe, orphaned when marauding raiders slaughter her family. Captured and sold into slavery, she finds herself thrust into the arena, fighting not just for her life but for her freedom. She is discovered by Thal, who sees potential in her, but there’s one tragic catch—she is mute, unable to speak.

As we follow her harrowing journey, we witness her struggle to survive, enduring the hardships of the brutal arena while navigating the treacherous web of power and deceit surrounding her. Will the mute girl rise to become the arena's new champion, or will she fall victim to the bloodthirsty Vera?

This is a tale of raw survival, betrayal, and forbidden desire, where every battle is a fight for life and every choice could mean death. The question is, will she conquer her silence and claim victory, or be consumed by the violence of the arena?

Features:

  • Explicit adult scenes

  • High-quality illustrations

  • All characters are 18+

content_descriptors.notes: Warning: This game contains scenes of violence, sexual violence, gladiatorial combat, sexual content with mythical creatures, group sex, and BDSM elements. 18+ only. Does not contain: alcohol/drug abuse, self-harm, or suicide.
